name: Israel, Gaza & region
summary: Houthis claim strikes on Saudi oil sites and Riyadh to 12 Nov as coalition hits Sanaa; Israeli strikes in Gaza continue
state: Saudi Arabia said its East-West oil pipeline was hit on 9 Nov and that the coalition intercepted missiles fired at Riyadh on 10 Nov, while Houthi media reported coalition strikes on Sanaa fuel sites (Al Jazeera, 10 Nov). On 12 Nov the Houthis claimed attacks on a pipeline pumping station and an Aramco building in Riyadh (Khaleej Times). In Gaza, medics said Israeli strikes and gunfire killed five people on 10 Nov despite the ceasefire (AP via AJC). Cross-border strikes on the Yemen–Saudi front set the Alert.
for_you: Travellers to Saudi Arabia, Yemen, Israel, Gaza or Lebanon should check FCDO travel advice, which can change at short notice. Flights in the region may be suspended or rerouted.
rubric_hit: Major cross-border strikes: Houthi missiles and drones on Saudi Arabia, coalition strikes on Sanaa 8–12 Nov (Alert)

rubric.alert: Multi-front escalation, major cross-border strikes between Israel and its neighbours, or mass-casualty events.

rubric.normal: Ceasefires holding across fronts (Gaza, Lebanon, Syria, Yemen).
